No neon accents, decorative progress scores, account avatar, or invented AI controls.

name: Slate
tagline: Native Android, with the details cared for.
rationale: A practical shipping direction: clean native-style navigation, separate ready and available subjects, legible storage information, and a dedicated download surface. Familiar Android patterns make the interface easy to learn.
designNote: Plan: canvas #F6F7FB, surface #FFFFFF, indigo #283E77, selection #E1E6F7, secondary ink #687080. One sans family with deliberate 32/18/14/11 type hierarchy. Layout: [Library] [segmented ready/available] [storage strip] [three ready rows] [active download] [navigation], all left aligned. Critique: removed the default giant rounded hero and detached card for every number. Storage is one quiet strip; downloadable subjects are grouped in one surface, and selected states use clear contrast rather than shadow.
